newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's TIM stock surges to highs in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Italy's TIM stock surges to highs in Milan.

text.p: Italian mobile phone operator Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) surged on a firmer Milan bourse, reaching a high for the year in active trade.
At 1048 GMT, TIM was 1.39 percent up at 5,845 lire with over 6.6 million shares changing hands after setting a new high at 5,870 lire.

Dealers said the stock, somewhat ignored in past weeks after a couple of downgrades, had taken off in the past days after a reconfirmed BUY recommendation from Salomon Brothers and on optimism boosted by half-year subscriber figures, put at nearly seven million by some London analysts.
Evan Miller of CSFB, which however does not use a target price, said "today's prices are not yet the limit."
Dealers added that targets just set by some analysts, like Salomon and Societe Generale's 6,000 lire, appeared to be on the cautious side given today's rise.

On the charts, said Carmine Curto di ADB, "a close above 5,850 lire would be positive. In this case the stock would top 6,000, the higher end of a rising track." But he said it was difficult to make evaluations when shares were at their highs.
